components.name: Journey
components.description: Signature: the path a request travels, current stop pulsing.
components.html:
1. 佳穎你
  2. 建宏林主管
  3. 雅婷王經理

narrative.overview: Every leave request is a trip with stops: you → 林主管 → 王經理. The system's job is to make who it is waiting on, and what happens next, impossible to miss. Everything else is borrowed from the macOS / iOS system idiom so nobody has to learn the tool.
keyCharacteristics: System font stack (SF / PingFang TC / Noto Sans TC), large bold titles, 17px body.
Inset grouped lists on #f5f5f7, white surfaces, 0.5px hairline separators.
One accent blue for actions and selection; green / orange / red / purple only for request state.
The Journey line — avatars on a rail with the current stop pulsing — wherever a request appears.
Sheets rise from the bottom (mobile) or float centered (desktop); confirms are inline, not nested modals.

rules.name: The State Owns Color Rule
rules.body: Green, orange, red and purple mean request state and nothing else.

rules.name: The Solid Red Rule
rules.body: White text sits on --red-fill (#d70015), never on the lighter --red.

rules.name: The Hours Are Words Rule
rules.body: Quantities are always written with their unit in plain language.

dos: Do show the Journey anywhere a request appears, and say in words who it is waiting on (「等林主管審核」).
Do show consequences before commitment: hours, remaining balance after, and the approval path live in the apply sheet.
Do warn inline with tinted notices (orange for advisories, red for blocks) and keep the submit button honest (disabled when blocked).
Do keep body text ≥16px and controls ≥40px tall.
donts: Don't use rings or sparklines for balances; use the horizontal meter (blue used, striped orange pending).
Don't open a modal on top of a sheet; confirm inline.
Don't put white text on the light --red or --accent text tokens in dark mode; use the fill tokens.
Don't add a second accent color.
